title: TickSpeedchallange
description: changes the tick speed every 5 minutes. when command /starttickrandom was executed
body: This Mod changes the Tickspeed to a random one every 5 Minutes when Command /starttickrandom was executed! This Command need **OP** **Permission** so make sure you have them. You can stop the 5 minute process by doing the command /stoptickrandom. It also requires **OP** **Permissions!**
